description_it: Insalata fresca con lattuga, pomodori, cetrioli, olive e olio EVO.
description_en: Fresh salad with lettuce, tomatoes, cucumbers, olives and EVO oil.
steps_it: Aggiungere pomodori a cubetti, cetrioli a rondelle e olive.
Condire con olio EVO, sale e origano.
steps_en: Add diced tomatoes, sliced cucumbers and olives.
Dress with EVO oil, salt and oregano.
